title: Jury Duty — Program Director Excusal Request
description: Short letter from the Program Director confirming a resident's training status and asking the court to excuse them from jury duty. Format follows the department's prior submission (John Hordines, September 2025): letterhead page, spelled-out date, 'To Whom It May Concern', three short paragraphs, typed signature block.

signer.name: Alex Sankin, M.D.
signer.title: Program Director, Urology Residency Training Program

paragraphs: I am writing to confirm the residency status of Dr. {name}. {Subj} is currently a {pgy} resident in the Department of Urology at Montefiore Hospital and is expected to graduate on June 30, {grad_year}.

Due to critical staffing needs, we respectfully request that Dr. {last} be excused from jury duty. {Poss} absence at this time could significantly impact the department and may result in an extension of {poss} residency training.
If you require any additional information or documentation, please do not hesitate to contact me.
